t: What Sustainable Aviation Fuel Scale-Up Is
title: What Sustainable Aviation Fuel Scale-Up Is
definition: Sustainable Aviation Fuel Scale-Up: scaling SAF to decarbonize flight.
description:
Strip Sustainable Aviation Fuel Scale-Up to its essence and you get scaling SAF to decarbonize flight. Simple to say, civilizational to build.

The path runs through Future Climate & Planetary Care: first SAF plants understanding, then scale logistics prototypes, then feedstock operations at scale. Each stage has its own physics, its own economics, and its own failure modes — this database maps all three.

Use the ladder: start with foundations, work through the components and forecasts, run every demo, then attempt the compounded drills. By the final record you will hold a working mental model of scale hulls, grounded in real research and honest about what remains unknown.

t: Real Research Today: Sustainable Aviation Fuel Scale-Up
title: Real Research Today: Sustainable Aviation Fuel Scale-Up
definition: Today's documented research behind Sustainable Aviation Fuel Scale-Up.
description:
The road to Sustainable Aviation Fuel Scale-Up is already being paved. Marine cloud brightening trials (Great Barrier Reef, Southern Ocean) test reef cooling. The IPCC AR6 reports document committed warming and remaining carbon budgets.

Enhanced rock weathering trials (Cascade, InPlanet) spread basalt on farmland. Together these programs form the SAF plants foundation that Sustainable Aviation Fuel Scale-Up will build on — the scale logistics results, the feedstock methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as scale logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

definition: Simulates Sustainable Aviation Fuel Scale-Up operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Sustainable Aviation Fuel Scale-Up installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 94301 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where SAF plants monitoring, scale logistics redundancy, or feedstock maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

t: Sustainable Aviation Fuel Scale-Up Master Roadmap
title: Sustainable Aviation Fuel Scale-Up Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Sustainable Aviation Fuel Scale-Up: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Sustainable Aviation Fuel Scale-Up — scaling SAF to decarbonize flight.

Phase 1 — Prove (SAF plants): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (scale logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (feedstock): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (blending): scale hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and aviation-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
